$comment: Request shape of the split metadata views. Cloudflare caches view=index and each view=catalog&provider=<kind> as independent URLs (public, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=600), so one edge can serve a new index next to an old catalog for up to ~15 minutes, and refetching the same index URL hits the same stale copy. Fix: (1) every catalog request carries rev=<the catalogRevision that the index the client is acting on announces for that provider> - the URL becomes content-addressed, a new revision is always an edge miss; when the index announces no catalogRevision for that provider the rev parameter is omitted (old shape). (2) the single index refetch performed after a revision mismatch carries fresh=<one-time value>, so it reaches the origin; the regular index fetch never carries fresh. The server ignores both parameters (same body and ETag as without them). Parameter values are URL-encoded ('sha256:' -> 'sha256%3A' is fine, servers decode). Each end names its tests CATALOG_REQUEST_SHAPE_<id> (Web: it('CATALOG-REQUEST-SHAPE-<id> ...')). Case catalog_request_without_announced_revision_omits_rev: ends that never request a catalog for a provider the index does not announce (Android syncCatalogsLocked, Web ensureCatalog) assert it at the URL-builder / transport layer (rev=null -> no rev parameter); that is conformant.
